content: Polyglot OpenAPI drift: pick ONE source of truth per service and gate it. Schema-first: hand-authored openapi.yaml authoritative, generate stubs/types, CI regenerates and git diff --exit-code fails on drift. Code-first: annotations authoritative, regenerated spec diffed in CI. FastAPI auto-generates specs from code but Malt engineering found its generated OAS 'not standardised enough' for Java/Kotlin consumers, motivating contract-first + openapi-generator. oasdiff classifies breaking changes between spec versions. Without ANY gate, spec silently lies (omitted nullable constraint crashes clients on real null).
